reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/input.rs borrows input and line-rendering owners. The file owns stack positions and render-decision scalars while borrowing ch input/cache state, line rendering owners and optional caller output slots.
owner_creation.invariant: Render cursors do not own the retained input bytes.
limitations: Rendering functions borrow line/cache owners rather than own their data.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/input.rs writes copied positions to caller slots. P_linepos/p_newline borrow caller storage and receive copies; pappend/prewind/loadc/savec mutate separate global line owners that cannot be replaced during the segment operation.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Output-slot writes require live caller storage throughout.
limitations: Returned positions are scalar copies, not lifetime tokens for cached lines.

callback_targets.analysis: src/input.rs calls filter and render operations directly. Prep_hilite/is_filtered and line/status operations are direct calls with no retained function pointer; they cross filter/render owners also touched by handlers.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct filter calls still require stable pattern owners.
limitations: Direct filter calls can overlap owner mutation by existing handlers.

invalidation.analysis: src/input.rs invalidates line content on seek and replay. Seek, prewind and replay can change cached/current line content; raw positions and saved rendering state must be revalidated when the input or line owner changes.
invalidation.invariant: A source offset is not a retained-buffer lifetime token.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/input.rs publishes outputs around incremental rendering. Sentinel outputs are installed early and final positions are written after rendering; the many line/cache/filter mutations are not a staged all-or-nothing owner transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: Partial rendering does not commit a complete line owner.

release_pair.analysis: src/input.rs acquires no local heap owner in these functions. No heap or FD is acquired in these function bodies; line/cache/ANSI owners are released by their own modules, never by freeing p_linepos/p_newline.
release_pair.invariant: Borrowed output arguments must not be deallocated here.
limitations: No local allocation does not imply that line and ANSI owners need no release.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/input.rs returns sentinel positions on local failure. Invalid positions, seek failure or missing bytes return -1 and null_line; these exits do not themselves prove all lower read errors were diagnosed correctly.
error_cleanup.invariant: Render failure cannot substitute for read-error evidence.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/input.rs can be interrupted while borrowing filter storage. SIGINT can mutate filter storage during prep/filter use, and asynchronous cleanup can retire input state; the source review retains the existing signal/raw-owner findings.
signals_handoff.invariant: Filter and input aliases are not yet signal-dispatch protected.
limitations: This reviews segment assembly and borrowed outputs only; it does not independently approve line.rs, search.rs or the complete compatibility/read campaign.

src/signal.rs.relationship: u_interrupt at src/signal.rs:44-56 replaces the filter with NULL; input.rs calls filter matching while rendering, so its borrowed filter storage can be retired by that handler.
